title: HackGuru Event Embedding Specification & Schema
description: Defines the semantic field selection, synthesis template, and embedding strategy derived from research/schema.json for all-MiniLM-L6-v2 vector indexing.

embedding_fields.description: Official title of the event; carries strongest semantic relevance.
Tagline summarizing format, duration, or key theme.
Event type (Hackathon, Workshop, Conference, Contest, Internship, Sports, Cultural).
City or region (e.g. Coimbatore, Chennai, Bengaluru, Online).
Host university, institute, or research campus.
Organizing club, student chapter, or company.
Key technical domains, tools, and topics (e.g. AI/ML, Web3, IoT, Robotics, Full Stack).
Target audience (e.g. engineering students, UG/PG, all developers).
Cash awards, cloud credits, grant pools, or certificates.
Detailed summary of challenges, tracks, and learning outcomes (truncated to avoid token overflow).

excluded_fields.reason: Database primary key; adds numerical noise with zero semantic value.
Static asset path; non-textual resource locator.
Display string representation better handled by deterministic filters.
Quantitative numerical value; used for exact range and Free/Paid boolean filtering.
Human readable date string; temporal queries are handled via date_range filters.
ISO date format; used for chronological ordering and temporal bounds checking.
ISO date format; used for deadline and expiration filtering.
Dynamic popularity counter; utilized in post-retrieval re-ranking formula.
UI presentation formatting of view counts.
Dynamic metric; used for trending/recommender signals, not semantic search.
Quality prior score used in stage-2 multi-objective scoring.
Boolean editorial flag used in promotion rules.
Boolean algorithmic flag used for discovery feeds.
Boolean flag redundant with mode filter.
Boolean lifecycle flag used for hard active-event filtering.

synthesis_template.format: Title: {title}. Subtitle: {subtitle}. Category: {category}. Format: {mode} in {location}. Organizer: {organizer} at {college}. Topics: {tags}. Eligibility: {eligibility}. Prizes: {prize_pool}. About: {description}
preprocessing_rules: Parse JSON tags array into comma-separated list of keywords.
Strip HTML tags or excessive whitespace characters.
Truncate description to max 120 words to ensure total synthetic text stays under 256 tokens.

runtime_storage.ram_structure: Contiguous float32 NumPy array of shape (N_events, 384) with L2 normalization
runtime_storage.sqlite_table: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS event_embeddings (event_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, embedding BLOB NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);
